description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.note: Signals are only generated within this GMT window. Outside this window the routine exits without posting.

macro_kill_switches.note: VIX above this level triggers an immediate halt — no signals issued.

risk.note: stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier × ATR14). target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier × ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr.

vix_regime.note: Above tighten_max the macro kill-switch fires. Between caution_max and tighten_max only HIGH-confidence signals (5-6) are issued.

volume.note: Percentages of 20-day average volume. Below neutral_pct the volume category is a non-confirm.
